reviews.text: Thank you for your review, Jessica! We appreciate you choosing Odyssey Pets. If there’s anything we could have done to make your experience five stars, we’d love to hear your feedback.

Amazing little pet store. I’m one of those psycho pet owners and I worked in Vet hospitals when I was younger so have higher standards and would trust my dog baby with thier staff. I’m mostly in there for DFWAPC meetings as I don’t live close so mostly get the pleasure of harrassing Miles and enjoying their fish and plant department but every staff member has a true love for animals is knowledgable, helpful, courteous and not afraid to say idk and ask another employee (one of my biggest pet peeves when people fake knowledge)
Great products. Great service. Very knowledgeable employees! This place is especially great for fish, if you're interested in that. I highly recommend Odyssey pets!
Been going there for 15 years because the groomers are kind and gentle to my 2 boys Ollie and Dickens. Great staff and clean boarding area. Highly recommend.

The best by far! People who are knowledgeable, approachable. They carry only transparent, healthy brands of dog and cat food. Great aquarium resource as well. Support a locally owned small business! Odyssey Pets is the best!

I purchased my Rummy Nose Tetras from Odyssey Pets. I stopped in, they only had a couple. Gentlemen gave me Miles card and told me to email him. Miles was great! He ordered me 20 Rummy Nose Tetras and I picked them up a week later. Video attached is after having them for 2 weeks. They are all healthy, happy, schooling and a  beautiful addition to my 75 gallon. Thank you Miles and everyone at Odyssey Pets. This was my 1st purchase, but definitely not my last! ❤️

Brought in both my girls for a day of beauty! Hannah is sooo good with them. Winnie is generally a little nervous when it comes to grooming but not with Hannah, both Roxie and Winnie came home feeling pretty.

I’ve been going to Odyssey Pets for years because they are a family, locally owned business that really care about their customers and their pets. Recently I had a surgery appt at 7:30am. I needed to leave my dog somewhere by 7:00am to be there on time. Odyssey Pets opens for drop off at 7:30am. However, I explained my situation to Miles, and he immediately volunteered to be there at 7:00 so I could make my appt.  Now, that is excellent customer service!  I’m so grateful for his help at a stressful time. Plus, my doggie loves going to daycare there!!

We  use Odyssey Pets for Boarding, Grooming, and Day Care services. They are so friendly and accommodating to me, but more importantly,  to my dog. She loved going there and I trust them with my girl.  I have peace of mind,  which is so important when you leave your pet someplace,  for ab hour,  a day,  or a week.  I trust them for recommendations for food,  snacks, and toys. I highly recommend them❤️
Owners are pretty weird

I went in to buy aquarium supplies and got help choosing the right filter and tank accessories. One staff member explained everything in simple terms, which helped a lot since I’m new to fish keeping. At checkout, there was a short delay because of a billing issue, but they handled it calmly. I did notice one aisle slightly disorganized, probably due to customer handling, but it didn’t stop me from finding what I needed. The guidance made the whole process smoother than expected.

I needed emergency food for my puppy late in the day, and this was the only shop open nearby. The staff was still polite even though it was close to closing time. They helped me choose something suitable quickly without overcomplicating things. One item wasn’t available, but they suggested a decent alternative. The checkout took a little longer because they were closing up, but they didn’t rush me. That patience made a stressful situation easier.

Best place EVER  extremely nice fish selection fresh and salt. Brandon is the man for all things freshwater and miles is the man for all things saltwater!!!! The buy 3 get one free on all aquatic plants is the best deal around.  The prices are always the best
Thank you, Gloria!

Love the selection of fish and pet supplies, and at first I was extremely pleased with the customer service. I realized a week later that the recommendation of fish from the employee was not going to work for my tank at all, and they were going to die if I kept them. I should have done more research, but I'd like to be able to trust employees to know the animals they're selling. No store credit or refund, I wish I had saved my time and money.

Great staff at Odyssey pets, always helpful with any questions you may have. They have a good selection of smaller brand or uncommon brand food and treats for cats and dogs. Particularly if you're looking for freeze dried raw and frozen raw food. They have dry and wet good. Various cat and dog toys as well.  They also have small selection of aquarium necessities and bird food.

Only bad experience I had was trying to order Farmina cat kibble. They are able to order brands they offer for you if they do not have specific item in-store. Their Farmina supplier kept shipping the wrong item. I waited 2 weeks before ordering directly from Farmina website and got my item within the week. I'm not sure who their Farming supplier is but if there is an item not offered in their store I'd get it directly from Farmina rather than order with them for in-store pickup.
Thank you, Tiffany!
Can someone please tell me the price of betta fish?
Thank you, Keaven!

Odyssey Pets grooming has been such a great find for us. Specifically sweet Hannah! She is so thoughtful and careful when grooming our Ollie. It is apparent that she is always making sure he’s comfortable and well taken care of. Not only does he look amazing after every appointment, but you can tell she genuinely cares about the pets she works with. We’re beyond grateful for her and wouldn’t take Ollie anywhere else!

Great store. Miles is very knowledgeable about anything aquarium related. If you have an aquarium at home, this local fish store is a great resource. They helped me set up a new system and even told me "no" a couple times when I was trying to buy stuff I didn't need, which shows true integrity. great selection of aquatic plants as well.
Nice pet store
Service is great and I always find a great deal in the Fish Room!
Great pet store
Fantastic mom and pop place for all your fish and dog/cat needs. They only stock the best stuff for your pet.

It was my first time visiting this place and im so glad I did. I was greeted with a big smile and a welcome. I started walking around, looking for fresh water plants and Miles comes and greets me again and we had a good conversation about shrimp and tetras.
They have Abundance of products specially for fresh water fish. Wide variety of fish and beautiful collection of neocaridina shrimp.
Ill definitely visit them again.
I forgot to take pics 📸 sorry 😞
Great place. It's staffed by knowledgeable enthusiasts. They have a personal touch and will help you source your needs if they can. A really great place.
Great place for pet grooming

This is the easily the best fish store I’ve ever been too. Miles is by far the coolest person in the fish community I have met. His customer service is impeccable and had an answer the every question I had. He’s patient and doesn’t pressure in any way and gets you excited about the process. The owner has incredible prices you can’t beat and is simply lucky to have an associate as enthusiastic as miles! 100% the only fish store I’ll be going to. They may not have as much inventory as Dallas north but the quality of their fish, plants and prices puts Dallas north aquarium to shame. Love this place!

Today was my first time visiting this store and WOW!! I’m blown away with the variety of both fish and plants they have. If you’re new to the fish hobby I highly recommend you visit and ask for Miles. Miles was a huge help with answering all of my stupid questions and helping me with every step of my visit! I look forward to my next visit and many more after that!
Thank you Odyssey pets team and Miles!
Excellent service. Has taken great care while grooming our dog. Very friendly staff. Highly recommended.

Gina is fantastic at grooming my pups, Chrissie and Mochi. She really knows how to handle their fluffy coats, and they always look amazing. Plus, the whole staff is so friendly and helpful. Support your local business!

I started taking my Henry here after a horrible experience at Petco down the street. He no longer comes out terrified after his appt and they always do an amazing job with him. He usually sees Aaliyah but their staff is so talented anybody you get will be amazing. Today was hectic with the winter storm coming in & he saw Hanna, she did an amazing job on him. THANK YOU! We love Odyssey Pets
Thank you, Jodi!
Thank you, Robin!
Great place for grooming or having your dog boarded

I have been taking my dog here for years. They always do a great job with her and she seems to do well there too! I typically drop her early and pick up after work, so she is there for a long time. We have never had any issues.

Being long haired, she gets a lot of mats and knots. She comes back so clean and smooth. We love odyssey
Friendly staff and wide selection for cats and dogs. No rodents, birds or lizards but had supplies for them. I got aome stocking staffers for my cat

Absolutely best pet/pet supply store around! It has a very mom and pop vibe. Everyone we've dealt with was well versed on all the supplies and they take the time to educate you. Real people work here not big box drones. Even if we didn't live close by, I would go out of my way to get here.
Odessey ‘s focus is high quality food and staff like Maria and Miles that provides the insight and guidance to support best choices.
Miles has helped me out many of times whether it be problems or finding me something I want. Great crew all around. Highly recommend stopping in.
Great staff.  The always have my dog food in stock.  Well stocked
Kirstin takes such great care of Sadie, our Cavalier, when we drop her off for grooming. She always comes home happy and looking beautiful!  Highly recommend and we love supporting small businesses.
Friendly, helpful, knowledgeable staff. Best products here. My dog is excited for doggy daycare!
Odyssey Pets is amazing!  They are so helpful in every way.  I buy everything from them for our new puppy and wouldn’t shop anywhere else! They are the best! You will love them!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
We took our Shih Tzu, Darla, to Oddyssey Pets today, and Hanna did an amazing job! She was super sweet and gentle with Darla, and you can tell she really knows how to handle dogs with care. Darla looks absolutely beautiful after her grooming session soft, clean, and perfectly styled!

The front desk staff were also so friendly and helpful. They took the time to explain more about Darla’s food options and helped us learn what’s best for her. Overall, such a great experience we’ll definitely be coming back!
Our Golden Doodle always looks amazing after her bath and cut from Kirsten! She’s the best.
Simply amazing!

I’ve boarded my dog at Odyssey Pets since he was a puppy. My dog is now fourteen years old, and there is no other place I would trust to board him! They take incredible care of my dog each time he stays with them. The Odyssey Pets’ staff members are incredibly helpful, caring, and attentive to pets’ needs. I would highly recommend Odyssey Pets to anyone looking for a trustworthy boarding facility!
Love the store amd staff here! Got me into the fish hobby and really helped me out with cycling my tank!

We love grooming services at Odyssey Pets! There are other groomers closer and more convenient to our location but we choose to drive out of our way because they do such a great job. Our lab is so happy when she gets there - no anxiety like she experienced with other places. She is clean. She is happy so we are happy. Hannah is a great groomer.

Kirstin consistently delivers as our groomer!!
I know my pup will be well taken care of and she always looks so cute! Kirstin goes above and beyond with the detail of her service! She is the only person I will take my dog to.
The best pet supplies store in Dallas! The folks at Odyssey specialize in the best products for your pets. They are knowledgeable and great to work with. Five stars...check it out!

I’ve been here to buy treats/toys and always had a great experience with the staff. Today we had our 8 month old standard poodle Piero groomed with Kirstin and he looks great! She did a fabulous pony cut and was super helpful with answering all of our questions. We will definitely be back.
Moose adores Ms.Gina never seen a dog more excited to get groomed
Thank you!

After moving to Fort Worth last year, let me just say that I’m devastated I can no longer bring my cavapoo, Wally, to get groomed by Gina at Odyssey Pets anymore. She always did such an outstanding job grooming him and I would absolutely still be bringing him to her if I lived closer. I’ve had Wally groomed many times at various places, and Gina is the ONLY groomer who has been able to achieve the look I’ve wanted. And no other groomer since has been able to replicate the adorable cut she was able to give him every time. Additionally, the other staff at Odyssey Pets was always so kind and pleasant to interact with, and the atmosphere of the store in general is delightful :) We really miss coming here and might just have to make a visit next time we’re in Dallas! Highly recommend their services if you’re in the Dallas/Addison area (and especially if you have a doodle)!!!
Thank you!

Miles was very polite, helpful, knowledgeable, and patient to answer questions I had about a product. I highly recommend this store for their kindness and reliability. Great product discussed as well.
Odyssey Pets is the best little local groomer around!
Helpful staff, amazing groomers, unique variety of products and quality healthy treats and food.
Mike is the best!
Thank you!
Odyssey Pets is the best pet store in DFW! You can trust all their products and Sherry the owner is wonderful.
Thank you!
The workers are very nice and so helpful, I will highly recommend this place 10/10!!!
Thank you, Charlie!

[Update: Manager Miles reached out to me expressing his apologies and explaining that this is not how this situation should have been handled. We returned to the store and they did give us a replacement fish. Miles was reasonable, courteous, respectful, and knowledgeable. I do believe that my previous experience is not the norm and I feel much more at peace now. I will continue to be a patron of Odyssey Pets. I have edited my rating to reflect this update and I do recommend interacting with Miles for a 5-star experience.]

Incredibly rude and disappointing customer service, no backing of their livestock. Absolutely lost a customer.

I bought a $30 fish which died within 2 days. Called the store to ask what to do, and was asked to bring the fish and a water sample. I said I could not go over the weekend, and they said it is fine. Came in on Monday, my water tested fine, but got a run around -- needed to come back for a manager. Manager denied refund/exchange and offered a tiny token discount off the purchase on a second fish. He stated that it had been too long, I do not purchase their store's water, any excuse possible to deny responsibility. He answered none of my questions on how long they have had the fish in or if they had quarantined, and told me to leave the store. I left empty-handed and feeling completely disrespected. I won't be back and do not recommend them.

Thank you so much for your review! We truly appreciate you taking the time to share your experience with us. We're always striving to provide the very best in pet care and customer service, so if there’s anything we can do to make your next visit a 5-star one, please don’t hesitate to let us know. We value your feedback and look forward to seeing you and your pet again soon!
Have been a customer at Odyssey pets for years. They always make my dog Zoe looks clean and awesome. Always does a good job with her tiny nails.
This is the only place I’ll trust my doggie to be boarded or groomed. Every time has been great. Here’s a pic after her recent groom and a cute thing they did when she was a puppy🥹🥰 …

Wonderful place! I had called a day before to inquire about Kuhli loaches and was greeted in a kind and helpful manner. I was so happy to hear they had my favorite noodly fish in stock, especially since all the other shops I've gone to seem to never restock them yet keep them listed. They have a wonderful selection of fish and plants for your tanks! They're more pricey than other locations but honestly it's worth it! I walked out not just with loaches but some platies and cardinal tetras too! Here's the best part, they also carry neocaridina shrimp in store!

This locally owned and operated pet store has Top of the Line products. And Fabulous grooming by Gina!
New groomer, Hannah, is fabulous! She anticipates my pet's every need - food, water, bathroom breaks. EVERYONE at this store is committed and great to work with!
Hanna is the best! We have a senior dog who needs, gentle attention and she always comes home happy and with no stress looking beautifully groomed! Hanna is very patient and kind!
Wonderful old-school INDEPENDENTLY OWNED pet store. Please support small businesses like this one. You will love the store, the staff, and the owners! ❤️

We love Odyssey! Hannah grooms my dog Betty who is scared of most people and she does an incredible job every time. Its hard to find a place that you can trust completely with your loved ones but everyone here shows a lot of care for each of their little personalities with all the good and bad. Highly recommend coming here to support a small business

I freaking LOVE this store. I love this store so much I would marry it. My cat is happy. My dog is happy. The food isn’t full of weird stuff that shouldn’t be in pet food. I trust that anything I buy there I will get my money’s worth. I freaking love this store. Don’t get me started on how much my cat loves their food. She used to be skin and bones because big brand pet food made her sick. Now she’s a chunky cat. Have I mentioned how much I LoOVVveeE this store?

I give them a 0/5
I’m extremely disappointed with the experience  We had at this grooming salon. We brought our dog in for a standard grooming session, and when we picked them up, we were shocked to find that there  is a big razor burn on his neck.

When we asked about it, the only explanation given was that our dog was “very matted” and that this was the reason for the condition of their skin. While we understand that matting can cause complications, there was no communication during the grooming process about the severity or what approach they planned to take. Most importantly, there was no mention of the razor burn when we arrived to pick our dog up.

Our dog is uncomfortable and in distress. I would have expected more transparency, care, and professionalism from any grooming service, especially when dealing with sensitive grooming outcomes.

We won’t be returning, and I strongly urge other pet owners to be cautious when considering this place. Your pet’s comfort and safety should always be the top priority — unfortunately, that didn’t seem to be the case here. I am attaching photos of our dog. If he is severely matted, they could have informed us that they won't be able to do the service, or heads up on when we picked him up, that there was a big razor burn. When asked about compensation or any refund, they said we didn't even take money for dematting fees, which they didn't have to do because they shaved the dog down, which was okay with us, but not this big razor burn. They go in circles with you saying the dog was matted. Please don't take your furbabies here.
Thank you, Tate!

**Review for Odyssey Pets**

I had a very disappointing experience at Odyssey Pets that I feel compelled to share. I was instructed to drop off my dogs between 10:00 and 11:00 AM, and I arrived at 10:45 AM, well within the time frame provided. However, when I got there, I was abruptly told that they couldn't groom my dogs because I was late. I was baffled, as I had spoken with a manager earlier who was very clear about the drop-off times.

Today, I had the misfortune of dealing with a manager named Alex, who was incredibly rude and dismissive. She completely disregarded what the other manager had communicated to me. After driving 35 minutes, I was turned away because Alex claimed that 10:30 AM was the last drop-off time. This is frustrating, considering I was only 15 minutes late based on the previous manager's instructions!

The overall disorganization and incompetence of this place are astounding. To make matters worse, I've been charged twice for their mistakes. I will never take my pets back here again. And the facility had a terrible smell, contaminated fish water, which makes me question the cleanliness and environment for the animals. It's hard to believe that anyone working there could be mentally sharp when they're surrounded by such unpleasantness. Breathing in toxic fumes! Save yourself the trouble and find a more honest reliable pet grooming service!
